;Gossip
A darkness has begun to creep into the Grim Reaches. My defenders are stretched thin and we are beset by enemies on all sides. While I was commanding the defenses of [[Baggoth's Wall]] the lands themselves have begun to be overrun by ghost and mongrel alike. I do hope you're here to assist, we could use any help we can get.
